test: Area-level replay. Rezoned lots = zoning changed between the release before adoption and MapPLUTO 25v3.1 within the community district (BBL match); homes built are counted on the same land by geometry. PlanArena applies its CEQR-style development-site screen (planarena/indicators/rwcds.py) under the new maximum FAR and projects homes; compared with the FEIS increment and with homes recorded by 2025. Mandatory Inclusionary Housing bonus FAR is not modelled.
